name: stacks-riskkit
description: Open-source risk primitives for Bitcoin-native applications on Stacks.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @stacks-riskkit/core && npm run build -w @stacks-riskkit/demo
scripts.test: npm run test -w @stacks-riskkit/core && npm run build -w @stacks-riskkit/core && npm run test -w @stacks-riskkit/demo
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @stacks-riskkit/core && npm run lint -w @stacks-riskkit/demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @stacks-riskkit/core && npm run build -w @stacks-riskkit/core && npm run typecheck -w @stacks-riskkit/demo
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @stacks-riskkit/core && npm run dev -w @stacks-riskkit/demo
